scope.targets: All existing prepared pathway/state/TF targets; native Y unchanged

invariants: reuse verified raw inputs and target-assay exclusion
all quality-eligible RNA retained; no correlation/FDR admission
patient-matched comparisons; failed targets and negative R2 retained
all fitted normalization, weights and hyperparameters training-only
no claim of causal activation or independent external validation

network_improvement.method: Network module ridge with independently signed coefficients
network_improvement.biological_vertices: lncRNA and gene-product anchors; raw RNA/CNV/mutation/protein/phosphosite features attach by verified gene identity
network_improvement.topology: Separate PPI, RPI and combined community partitions from existing verified authority; no outcome-driven edges
network_improvement.mechanism: Network membership shares shrinkage strength, never forces equal or same-sign coefficients
network_improvement.weights: Training-only kernel alignment reweights feature groups, with power 0 exactly recovering equal-modality ridge
network_improvement.null: Independent degree-preserving edge swaps within PPI and bipartite RPI, same weights distribution; same fitting/tuning procedure
network_improvement.orphans: Retain unmapped and disconnected features in modality-specific background groups

primary_contrasts: module_ridge_union vs all five module_ridge_union_random seeds
all three RNA arms with identical allowed inputs and patients
secondary_contrasts: RNA increment over shared omics baseline
uncertainty: Paired patient bootstrap within cancer, averaging correlated targets by family; compare outer-repeat consistency; random-graph ensemble is a diagnostic control, not an automatic p<0.05 test
deliverables: complete repeated nested CV for three cancers and all three arms
figures and report in requested Windows picture directory

amendment.rna_proxy_types: PPI coding-to-coding; RPI lncRNA-to-coding; no gene-biotype alias edges
